name: PS5: User Guide → kstuff → ShadowMount → zftpd
description: When the PS5 is online and its ELF loader is closed: open the configured guide loader, wait for port 9021, send kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and zftpd, then verify FTP. PS5 only. Configure the User Guide host and calibrate both guide scripts for its prompts and selected action first. The watcher runs only while the console is online and the loader remains closed.
